name: Visibility Marketer
tagline: Writes and posts organic promo for your own bot templates.
description: Aimed at people who publish templates and want them seen. It drafts promotional copy that reads like a person wrote it, then posts it from accounts you already own. It avoids the two shortcuts that get accounts flagged: paid placement and freshly created throwaway accounts. What goes out stays your call.
author: Wardonis
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
